summary: Example callbacks: log_plays records playbook events to a log file, mail sends email on failures and say speaks playbook events with synthesized speech.
questions: Is there a callback to log playbook runs to a file?
How can I get emailed when a playbook fails?

answer_card.title: Example callback plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
- `log_plays`: records playbook events to a log file.
- `mail`: sends email on playbook failures.
- `say`: announces events with synthesized speech.
